# Three.js 0.180.0 (r180)

Unmodified official release files, bundled for offline use. The renderer module
imports the adjacent core module. They are loaded on demand by `js/ground.js`;
no CDN, import map, build step, API key, or additional controls library is used.

- [Renderer module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r180/build/three.module.min.js)
- [Core module](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r180/build/three.core.min.js)
- [MIT license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r180/LICENSE), preserved in `three-LICENSE.txt`.
